title: Code_Wes club numbers
description: The numbers at the top of /log. Only the board adds a number here, and each one says what it counts and where it came from. Empty means nothing is shown.

founded.description: The year Code_Wes started. The site shows how many years that is.

foundedSource.description: How we know, such as "WesNest registration".

label.description: Plural noun phrase shown after the number, such as "hackathons organized".

counts.description: Exactly what is counted, such as "people who attended at least one workshop".

source.description: Where the number came from, such as "workshop sign-in sheets, 2023 to 2026".
